trial_court: Court of Shri Ajay Kumar Malik : Additional Senior Civil Judge of South West District at Dwarka Courts, New Delhi (CS SCJ. 426032/16)
case_name: Azad Singh vs Devi Singh Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sh Kuldeep Singh Phalswal, Smt. Suman w/o Sh Baljit Singh, Smt. Geeta Devi w/o Sh Satyawan (plaintiffs)
parties.respondent_defendant: Sh Devi Singh, Sh Dharampal, Sumitra, Hoshiyar Singh, Deepak, Late Smt. Sushila alias Gyano w/o Late Sh Parvesh, Master Himanshu, Miss Himanshi, Master Harsh, Smt. Omwati w/o Sh Mahender Singh, Smt. Roop Kaur, Smt. Ishwanti, Smt. Bala (defendants)

facts_of_case: Suit for declaration and permanent injunction filed by plaintiffs against defendants to declare defendants as illegitimate children of deceased Sardar Singh and nullify mutation order dated 22.06.2013.

legal_principles.principle: A factum of marriage is essential for the purposes of applicability of Section 16 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: Whether a factum of marriage (void/voidable) is essential for the purposes of applicability of Section 16 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 (OPP)

legal_principles.principle: A suit is barred by limitation if the plaintiff fails to file it within the statutory period.
legal_principles.held: Whether the suit of the plaintiff is barred by limitation? (OPD)

outcome.final_order: The trial court granted the relief claimed by the plaintiff, declaring the defendants as illegitimate children of deceased Sardar Singh and restraining them from selling or alienating the suit property.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in Hindu undivided family matters
